guidance: 2002: people hand out goals (cyan arrows over givers); chase/race goals show a red arrow; View Goals can jump to a goal's start (LP4 1:39:50)
2002: S-K-A-T-E letters sit on layer transitions of one climbing line (rail->wire, roof->roof, roof->kicker, QP->roof, scaffold bend) (THG)
2002: rivets glow bright orange and draw their own line (THG)
2025: tape hidden from spawn, alley and door; revealed only by turning right on the roof (PS34 #40)
2025: door marked by a green arrow sign and a lit opening at the end of a coned alley (PS34 #38-#39)
2025: pause-screen protip says other goals may unlock the way to tapes (generic; LP34 4:14:40)
PS1: the S-K-A-T-E Hard letters ring the tape's building on the VG render (inferred sightline)
designLogic: 2002 has no tape; its secrets are entrances (QP into a floor hatch) and goals on moving machinery
2025 tape: a doorway does the climb, placing the tape ~15-25 s from spawn on a large map
the tape rewards restraint: slow roll-off catches it, a fast launch overshoots
one door serves the tape, the panda and two vent-rail gaps: a single discovery pays three times
the remake promotes existing 2002 geometry (vents: 'Ventilation Claustrophobia') into the tape landmark and a pro goal
moving machinery is the level theme: crane lip ride, swinging/spinning containers, train manual, moving walkway, moving container
2002 S-K-A-T-E is a tour of every vertical layer (1:48 of 2:00)
combo sets graduate: wallride+kicker -> bowls+spine+revert -> spine onto a roof and an air to a hidden platform
water is the cheap failure line; the alley drop under the 2025 tape is the only long fall and the door undoes it
PS1: one keyed room and a tape on the highest open-air rooftop block whose edges are scored gaps
both later lineages put one collectible on a moving object (PS1 deck on crane beam; 2025 logo in shuttling container)
2025 cash teaches the wire and container-interior layers the bigger secrets use
remakeChanges: Tape: none in PS2 2002; PS1 edition hides an unlisted tape on a rooftop brick structure; 2025 lists 'Get the Secret Tape' mid-air under a duct between the central warehouse roofs
2025 adds a Rooftops door (transition) that no 2002 source mentions (low-confidence negative evidence)

2025 keeps S-K-A-T-E, welders, rivets (21 -> 7), train manual, buoy (5 bell grinds -> one Hardflip grind); drops Dog Chase, container inventory, shack water gap, competition; adds tape, Ollie North across roofs, Judo across containers, vent rails
2025 S-K-A-T-E is a short row beside the spawn instead of the 2002 1:48 vertical tour
2002 free roam with per-goal clocks -> 2025 10:00 runs
transfer: Slow drop-off crystal: crystal ~1.5-2.5 m beyond and ~1 m below the end of a grindable duct over a 6-10 m alley; a 4 m/s roll-off passes through it (1.8 m travel per 1 m drop) while a 12 m/s launch overshoots (~5.4 m); respawn ledge or lift makes a miss cost ~10 s
Shortcut lift/ramp from near the spawn onto the roof layer; hide the crystal opposite the arrival view
Hatch entrance: aim a QP air into a roof hatch -> interior corridor with rails -> kicker over water with the crystal in the arc
Swinging-container spine chain: three moving mini-halfpipe platforms in a row, crystal over the third
Waterside rail -> sloped cable up to a roof; shards at each transition; crystal one grind-ollie (~2.4 m pop) hop past the last roof gap
Pedestal crystal on a raised rooftop block whose top edges are grindable, approached by a ramp from a higher stack (PS1 style)
